newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall 2.05 pct after cabinet changes.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall 2.05 pct after cabinet changes.

text.p: Thai stocks fell more than two percent during late morning trade on concerns over government stability after a cabinet reshuffle on Friday created conflicts within the ruling coalition, brokers said on Monday.
The composite SET index retreated 2.05 percent to 610.46 on thin 596 million baht turnover at 0428 GMT.
"Investors thought that the reshuffle on Friday won't improve government image. Some have started making a countdown on the life of this government," said Bunsom Kesapradist of Asia Credit.
Bangkok Bank topped the active list, falling three baht to 165, and Nava Finance shed 1.50 to 26.50.
The index later recovered to 612.98 by 0447 GMT .
